title: Report a bank's coverage apart from quality
statement: When items are served from a bank of pre-checked items, report how many fresh requests the bank covers separately from how good its items are.
example: A bank-backed solver passed 37 of 50 fresh requests: every pass was a bank hit, and all 13 misses were topics the bank lacked.
detail: In the AP work, a solver that served pre-checked items from a cache passed 37 of 50 fresh requests on a held-out set; all 37 passes were cache hits, and all 13 misses were requests for sub-standards the cache did not hold (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/BEADS.md`). Another cache layer was recorded as delivering 99.7% on the four of five item types it covered (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_v2_2026_06_02.md`). An analysis of an earlier version of the solver judged its deterministic templates to be cherry-picking by another name (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/BEADS.md`).
against: Both figures come from banks built by agents for narrow scopes: one unit, and four of five item types.

evidence.quote: 37 passes = cache hits; 13 cap_reached = substandards not in cache.
